description: This Java source file defines a class 'ImmutableAttributesBuilder' which is a mutable builder for constructing immutable attributes objects utilizing a fluent API. It includes methods for setting, removing, and building JSON-based attributes, and interacts with other JSON utility classes within the project.

classes.name: ImmutableAttributesBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing 'AttributesBuilder' that provides a fluent API to construct a JSON-based immutable attributes object. It manages an internal 'JsonObjectBuilder' instance to build and manipulate attribute data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns a new empty instance of 'ImmutableAttributesBuilder'.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of 'ImmutableAttributesBuilder' initialized with values from a given JSON object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Multiple overloads to set various types of key-value pairs (int, long, double, boolean, String, JsonValue, JsonFieldDefinition) in the JSON object.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the specified key or field definition from the JSON object.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple JSON fields at once from an iterable collection, with filtering via a predicate.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the internal JSON object builder is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of fields in the current JSON object being built.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a stream of JSON fields contained in the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable 'Attributes' instance based on the current state of the JSON object.
